adjudication.rationale: The diff shows `group.users.delete(user_id)` on line 90 of groups_controller.rb. ActiveRecord's `delete` method on a has_many association removes records by ID but doesn't raise an error or return a meaningful result if the ID doesn't exist in the association. The code then proceeds to `group.save` and returns `success_json` regardless of whether any user was actually removed. This means the API will report success even when attempting to remove a non-member or non-existent user, which is misleading behavior.
